reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: INIT_ARRAY owns one typed C-ABI code address retained by used/init_array attributes in the executable image.
owner_creation.invariant: The callback table has one fixed C-ABI entry.
limitations: INIT_ARRAY owns one image function pointer, not the help array.

aliases_escapes.analysis: The loader borrows the retained table; INIT_ARRAY's element points to image code with no captured stack or heap context.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Startup callbacks retain no temporary data aliases.
limitations: The loader retains the target address for constructor dispatch only.

callback_targets.analysis: INIT_ARRAY names c2rust_run_static_initializers, which computes size_helpdata without allocation or application callbacks.
callback_targets.invariant: The initializer target is explicit and nonallocating.
limitations: The fixed help image is reviewed here; lmsg allocated replacements, help_data aliases and retained-input owners remain separate pending reviews.
The constructor target is fixed; arbitrary native callback tables are outside this record.

invalidation.analysis: The function-pointer array is shared and immutable; no runtime replacement or unloading invalidates INIT_ARRAY's target.
invalidation.invariant: Callback address and code lifetime match the image.

mutation_commit.analysis: Static initialization fixes the INIT_ARRAY table before loader traversal, and traversal establishes the default help length before main.
mutation_commit.invariant: Constructor dispatch completes before help use.

release_pair.analysis: INIT_ARRAY and its callback code share image lifetime; a loader startup table is not an allocator-owned object to free.
release_pair.invariant: Code addresses are not allocator-owned buffers.
limitations: Releasing image metadata is process teardown, not a manual free of INIT_ARRAY.

error_cleanup.analysis: The INIT_ARRAY target performs constant size computation and one scalar assignment, so no partial resource owner needs rollback.
error_cleanup.invariant: The constructor needs no error cleanup owner.

signals_handoff.analysis: The INIT_ARRAY target runs as a loader constructor and returns before application handler registration; it is not an asynchronous handler.
signals_handoff.invariant: Constructor execution does not interrupt pager mutation.
